# Implementation Plan: Storage Location Management (UI)

**Branch**: `003-inventory-location-admin` | **Date**: 2026-05-16 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)  
**Input**: Feature specification at `specs/inventory-service/storage-locations/location-management-ui/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-plan`. Task breakdown: run `/speckit-tasks` next.

## Summary

Deliver an operator **admin page** in `ui/` to list, create, edit, and deactivate **storage locations**, backed by extended **inventory-service** APIs. Today only `GET` (active-only) and `POST` exist; this plan adds admin list (`?all=1`), `PUT` update, and `POST .../deactivate` with a stock-balance guard. Movement pages keep using active-only locations (FR-006, FR-008).

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: PHP 8.2+ (Laravel 11), TypeScript (React 18 via Vite)  
**Primary Dependencies**: Eloquent, React, Tailwind CSS, existing `ui/src/api/inventory.ts`  
**Storage**: MySQL `storage_locations` (existing table; no new migration)  
**Testing**: PHPUnit unit + feature tests; Vitest for UI helpers/components  
**Target Platform**: Docker Compose (inventory :8004, UI gateway)  
**Project Type**: Monorepo web service + SPA  
**Performance Goals**: Location list &lt;200ms p95 local; admin page usable with ≤100 locations  
**Constraints**: Dedicated page (UI-001); modals only for deactivate confirm (UI-002); no hard delete  
**Scale/Scope**: Small catalog (&lt;100 warehouses); 1 new UI page + 3 API extensions

## Complexity Tracking

| Violation | Why Needed | Simpler Alternative Rejected Because |
|-----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| Two modules (`inventory-service` + `ui`) | Spec FR-001 requires dedicated UI route and navigation | API-only fails SC-001/SC-005 usability goals |
| `?all=1` query on list endpoint | Single resource, two consumers (admin vs selectors) | Duplicate admin route adds maintenance without benefit |
